insurer: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
plan_name: Arogya Sanjeevani Policy, The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (standard range ₹1L–₹5L per IRDAI Arogya Sanjeevani guidelines)

room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment applies to every admissible claim for all insured persons

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments at 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year (whichever lower); modern treatments (robotic surgery, HIFU, deep brain stimulation etc.) capped at 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; waived if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Table of Benefits states 4 years (48 months) for declared PEDs; policy clause 6.1 states 36 months — Table of Benefits takes precedence as product-specific; reducible via portability credit

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months for most listed conditions (hernia, cataract, hydrocele, piles, etc.); 36 months for joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy wording

day_care.note: Extensive list of 280 procedures in Annexure C covered

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded (clause 7.18)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to full SI per policy year

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expense cover in policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Gloves, masks, nebuliser kits and many consumables explicitly excluded in Annexure A List I

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded (clause 7.19 and 10.7)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to enhanced SI from date of enhancement

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly premium mode

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies with term ≥1 year; not on renewals or porting

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 30 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary/OPD, maternity, infertility/IVF, overseas treatment, refractive error <7.5D, consumables (gloves, masks etc.)

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons described in policy wording
